name: CodeCopyButton
description: Icon-only copy control for code surfaces: the copy glyph swaps to a check after a successful copy and a live region announces the result.

keyboard: Tab focuses the button; Enter or Space copies.
ariaRequirements: The button is named by label (default "Copy code", translated).
A polite live region announces Copied or Copy failed; the glyph swap alone is silent.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-25: built from the Figma component (Astryx Code/CodeBlock and Geist code/code-block/snippet benchmarks) to replace CodeBlockWindow and CodeSnippet.

prefersOver: IconButton for copy-to-clipboard on code surfaces
forbiddenUse: Use as a general action button; it only copies.
dense: 28px icon-only copy button; copy glyph to check on success; value string or getter; live-region announcement

usage.description: CodeCopyButton copies a string to the clipboard and confirms it in place. CodeBlock and Snippet use it; reach for it directly only when building another code surface.

bestPractices.description: Pass value as a getter when the text is expensive to build or changes after render.
Keep the default label unless the surface copies something other than code, such as a command or a URL.
Do not put it on plain prose; selection already covers copying text.
Do not rely on the check mark alone to report success; the live region is part of the control.

value.description: Text to copy, or a function that returns it at click time.

onCopy.description: Called with the copied text after a successful copy.

resetAfterMs.description: How long the check mark stays, in milliseconds.
